# AniStream v2.2.2

AniStream now keeps working without a connection: watch downloaded episodes, read downloaded
chapters, and let downloads finish after you close the window.

## New

- 🎉 Read manga offline: Download chapters at original quality from a title's chapter list.
  Offline, Manga shows your downloaded titles and their chapters, ready to read
- 🎉 Keep running in the background (Windows, off by default): Closing the window can keep
  AniStream in the system tray, so it reopens instantly. Turn it on in **Settings → General**
- 🎉 Finish downloads after closing: Close AniStream mid-download and it can keep going in the
  tray, then quit by itself and let you know when it's done

## Better

- ⚡️ Made for offline: Every section says when you're offline and shows what it saved, then fills
  in by itself when you reconnect
- ⚡️ Downloads wait out a lost connection and pick up where they left off, run about 20% faster,
  and show sizes close to the real file
- ⚡️ Downloaded anime works offline: Its page lists just your downloaded episodes, with posters
  and previews
- ⚡️ The own player starts at the quality your connection can carry, and carries on after a
  dropped connection
- ⚡️ Search shows results right on the page as you type, without a menu covering the top result
- 💄 A new season picker with artwork for each season
- 💄 Cleaner manga title pages: fewer repeated cards, and titles you can't read here link to their
  official sites

## Fixed

- 🦺 Opening AniStream offline showed an AniList error and waited for a click
- 🦺 Offline, Movies & TV search said "No matches", the schedule showed an empty week, and Movies &
  TV asked you to set up TMDB
- 🦺 Download sizes were overstated, up to twice the real size
- 🦺 Some manga said "No English chapters" when the extra chapter source just couldn't be checked;
  it now says so and offers **Try again**
- 🔒 Stronger protection: players and downloads can't reach your sign-ins or AniStream's own
  internals, and AniList sign-in links can't be forged

## Downloads

- `AniStream-2.2.2-arm64.dmg`: Apple Silicon macOS 12+
- `AniStream.Setup.2.2.2.exe`: Windows x64

On Windows, AniStream downloads this update in the background and installs it when you choose
**Restart to update**. You can also install over your existing copy; your data and AniList session
are kept. macOS links to this release page.

Both packages are unsigned. On Windows, select **More info → Run anyway** if SmartScreen warns
you. On macOS, choose **Open Anyway** in **System Settings → Privacy & Security** after the first
launch. Check a download against the attached `SHA256SUMS.txt`, or confirm it was built by this
project's release workflow with
`gh attestation verify AniStream.Setup.2.2.2.exe --repo Athen2045/AniStream`.
